competing_explanation: The policy may have been updated to a different duration (such as 14 or 60 days) or may exclude certain categories of 'standard' items from the full-refund guarantee.
hypothesis_statement: The current 30-day full-refund return window for standard items is exactly 30 days from the date of delivery.
refutation_criterion: Evidence showing the window is less than, greater than, or conditional upon factors other than the standard 30-day period (e.g., 14 days, 60 days, or requiring original packaging only).
